name: test-process-lifecycle
goal: A check or automated test stops every process it started: the packed report smoke test ends its own server and removes its fixture, and a verification check that leaves a descendant running cannot pass

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: test/packaged-reports.e2e.test.ts started harness report serve and by its own comment left the server and its fixture directory on every run: about 35 detached report servers with deleted working directories had accumulated since Oct 9, one per full check. There was no supported way to end such a server: serve returned no process identity and no stop existed. The verification runner killed only the process group of a check, so a check that started a daemon in another session reported passed while the daemon ran on. Prior behaviour is unchanged for a person: report serve still leaves its server running.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Kept under work/logs. stage-f-packed-lifecycle-red.log: 2 failed, report stop --port N failed with 1, and the run left two servers (ended by hand, identified as that run's by their working directory). stage-f-descendant-leak-red.log: runIsolated reported no survivors for a detached daemon, and harness verify run recorded [0, passed] for a check that left one.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: The report store records the server it starts (pid, port, start time, build) and harness report stop ends exactly that process, known by id and start time and never by its port. The smoke test starts its server through a helper that stops it in finally and removes its fixture. The runner follows each check's processes by parent links and fails a check whose descendant is still running after it ended. Guards: the lifecycle test in the package suite, the daemon tests in the unit and CLI suites.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: packages/reports: reportServerRecord.ts (record, processStarted, stopReportServer), ReportServerService.serve returns and records the pid, report stop. Root: processDescendants.ts, runIsolated returns survivors and a command that left any has not passed, CheckRunService words the failure. test/support/packedReports.ts gives the smoke test packedInstall and withReportServer; browserRun.stop interrupts a run so it ends its own servers. All three tests are in bun run check (test:unit, test:e2e, test:package).

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: test/packaged-reports.e2e.test.ts 3 passed with no new server and no fixture directory left (stage-f-packed-lifecycle-green-1.log); test/utils/run-isolated.test.ts 5 passed and test/verify-leak.e2e.test.ts 1 passed with test/verify-negative.e2e.test.ts 8 passed (stage-f-descendant-leak-green-1.log); unit tests report-server-record (2) and process-descendants (2). Changes to the tests after their red runs are in work/logs/stage-f-test-diff.log.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The guard is the red run itself on the unchanged product: with no stop lifecycle the lifecycle test fails and with the runner as it was the daemon tests fail (logs above). Seven real checks run through the repaired runner end with no survivor (stage-f-leak-probe-*.log: a browser spec, the picker spec, the packed smoke test, the kernel CLI, the edge and bucket Workers tests); in one run a failing concurrent-run test left ten processes of its own and the runner stopped and reported them.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Full bun run check exit 0 (work/logs/stage-f-check-4.log): 445 unit tests in 133 files with 25 live-API tests skipped, 176 CLI end-to-end tests in 54 files, 27 package tests in 10 files with the 3 index-gated scale tests skipped, 116 reports unit tests in 53 files, cargo fmt, clippy and tests, both audits, units check 537 units with 15 uncertain references. The check left no new packed report server: 29 older ones before and after, none of them touched. harness explain check: 175 reasons for the stage, 392 from 6cf10dd, 537 from an empty start. No user-visible flow changed, so no browser pass was repeated for this repair.
